mapper.select: SELECT MAX(d_seq) as d_seq FROM approval_d where appr_no = #{appr_no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_m ( SEQ, EMP_NO, USER_NM, PROJ_CODE, PROJ_NAME, TEMP_FLAG, CRTDATE ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{empNo}, #{userNm}, #{projCode}, #{projName}, #{temp_flag}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO contract_d ( SEQ, CONT_DATE, CONT_PERIOD, MOVE_DATE, CONT_AMT, DEPOSIT_AMT, RENT_AMT, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_D, POST_CODE, RES_TYPE, TRANS_TYPE, AREA, CRTDATE, ACCU, ACCU_TYPE, SOURCE, CHK_1, CHK_2, CHK_3, CHK_4, CHK_5, REAL_ESTATE_FILES, CREDIT_FILES , CHK_REASON_1 , CHK_REASON_2 , CHK_REASON_3 , CHK_REASON_4 , CHK_REASON_5 ) VALUES ( #{seq}, #{contDate}, #{cont_period}, #{moveDate}, #{contAmt}, #{depositAmt}, #{rentAmt}, #{address}, #{addressD}, #{post_code}, #{resType}, #{transType}, #{area}, NOW(), #{accu}, #{accu_type}, #{source}, #{chk1}, #{chk2}, #{chk3}, #{chk4}, #{chk5}, #{realEstateFiles}, #{creditFiles} , #{chkReason1} , #{chkReason2} , #{chkReason3} , #{chkReason4} , #{chkReason5} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, m.rewrite, d.cont_date, d.cont_period, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.post_code, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.accu_type, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, d.real_estate_files, d.credit_files FROM contract_m m , contract_d d WHERE m.seq = d.seq and m.seq = #{seq}

SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.cont_period, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.post_code, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.accu_type, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, d.real_estate_files, d.credit_files FROM contract_m m , contract_d d WHERE m.seq = d.seq and m.temp_flag = 'Y' and m.emp_no = #{user_no} ORDER BY d.crtdate DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, m.proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.cont_period, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.post_code, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.accu_type, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, d.real_estate_files, d.credit_files FROM contract_m m , contract_d d , approval_m am WHERE m.appr_no = ( SELECT appr_no FROM contract_m WHERE seq = #{seq} ) AND am.appr_no = m.appr_no AND d.seq = m.seq

SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, CAST(m.proj_code AS CHAR) as proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.cont_period, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.post_code, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.accu_type, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, d.real_estate_files, d.credit_files, dcd.lessor, dcd.lessor_name as lessorName, dcd.lessor_account as lessorAccount, dcd.lessor_bank as lessorBank, NULL as existingCustCode, dcd.cust_code as custCode, dcd.payment_date as paymentDate FROM contract_m m INNER JOIN contract_d d ON d.seq = m.seq INNER JOIN approval_m am ON am.appr_no = m.appr_no LEFT JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON dcd.contract_seq = m.seq WHERE m.appr_no = #{appr_no}

SELECT m.seq, m.emp_no, m.user_nm, CAST(m.proj_code AS CHAR) as proj_code, m.proj_name, m.appr_no, d.cont_date, d.cont_period, d.move_date, d.cont_amt, d.deposit_amt, d.rent_amt, d.address, d.address_d, d.post_code, d.res_type, d.trans_type, d.area, d.crtdate, d.accu, d.accu_type, d.source, d.chk_1, d.chk_2, d.chk_3, d.chk_4, d.chk_5, d.chk_reason_1, d.chk_reason_2, d.chk_reason_3, d.chk_reason_4, d.chk_reason_5, d.real_estate_files, d.credit_files, dcd.lessor, dcd.lessor_name as lessorName, dcd.lessor_account as lessorAccount, dcd.lessor_bank as lessorBank, NULL as existingCustCode, dcd.cust_code as custCode, dcd.payment_date as paymentDate FROM contract_m m INNER JOIN contract_d d ON d.seq = m.seq INNER JOIN approval_m am ON am.appr_no = m.appr_no LEFT JOIN draft_contract_detail dcd ON dcd.contract_seq = m.seq WHERE m.appr_no = #{appr_no} AND m.seq NOT IN ( SELECT dcd2.contract_seq FROM draft_contract_detail dcd2 WHERE dcd2.contract_seq IS NOT NULL )

SELECT a.appr_no -- 결재번호 ,a.emp_no -- 작성자 ,a.user_nm -- 작성자 ,a.proj_code -- 사용현장 ,a.proj_name -- 사용현장 ,a.address -- 주소 ,d.d_seq -- 결재상세SEQ ,d.appr_num -- 결재라인번호 ,d.appr_emp_no -- 결재자 ,d.appr_emp_nm -- 결재자 ,d.appr_position -- 결재자 직급 ,d.first_appr_emp_nm -- 최초결재 ,d.first_appr_date -- 최초결재일자 ,d.next_appr_emp_nm -- 다음결재자 ,d.last_appr_emp_nm -- 최종결재자 ,d.last_appr_date -- 최종결재일자 ,d.appr_stat -- 결재상태 FROM ( SELECT a.appr_no, MAX(a.emp_no) AS emp_no , MAX(a.user_nm) AS user_nm , MAX(a.proj_code) AS proj_code , MAX(a.proj_name) AS proj_name , MAX(a.crtdate) AS crtdate , CONCAT(MAX(CONCAT(b.address,' ',b.address_d)),(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN CONCAT(' 외 ',COUNT(*)-1,'건') ELSE '' END)) AS address FROM contract_m a JOIN contract_d b ON a.seq=b.seq AND a.appr_no IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.appr_no ) a JOIN ( SELECT c.appr_no ,c.appr_stat ,c.appr_admin ,c.d_seq ,c.appr_num ,c.appr_emp_no ,c.appr_emp_nm ,c.appr_remarks ,c.appr_date ,c.appr_position ,c.last_tag ,c.appr_tg ,c.appr_group ,c.first_appr_emp_nm ,c.first_appr_date ,c.last_appr_emp_nm ,c.last_appr_date ,c.next_appr_emp_nm FROM ( SELECT b.rnum ,b.appr_no ,b.appr_stat ,b.appr_admin ,b.d_seq ,b.appr_num ,b.appr_emp_no ,b.appr_emp_nm ,b.appr_remarks ,b.appr_date ,b.appr_position ,b.last_tag ,b.appr_tg ,b.appr_group ,b.first_appr_emp_nm ,b.first_appr_date ,MAX(CASE WHEN appr_num = last_appr_c_num AND appr_tg = 'T' THEN appr_emp_nm ELSE '' END)OVER( PARTITION BY appr_no) AS last_appr_emp_nm ,MAX(CASE WHEN appr_num = last_appr_c_num AND appr_tg = 'T' THEN appr_date ELSE NULL END)OVER( PARTITION BY appr_no) AS last_appr_date ,(CASE WHEN appr_group = 'A' AND next_appr_emp_nm = '' THEN '업무지원팀' ELSE next_appr_emp_nm END) next_appr_emp_nm FROM ( SELECT a1.appr_no, a1.appr_stat, a1.appr_admin , a2.d_seq, a2.appr_num, a2.appr_emp_no, a2.appr_emp_nm, a2.appr_remarks , (CASE WHEN appr_tg = 'T' THEN a2.appr_date ELSE NULL END) AS appr_date , a2.appr_position, a2.last_tag, IFNULL(a2.appr_tg,'N') AS appr_tg , a2.appr_group , LAG(a2.appr_emp_nm,1,'')OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no ORDER BY a2.appr_num DESC) AS next_appr_emp_nm , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_num = 0 THEN a2.appr_emp_nm ELSE '' END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS first_appr_emp_nm , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_num = 0 THEN a2.appr_date ELSE NULL END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS first_appr_date , MAX(a2.appr_num)OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS last_appr_num , ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no ORDER BY a2.appr_num DESC) AS rnum , MAX(CASE WHEN a2.appr_tg = 'T' THEN a2.appr_num ELSE 0 END )OVER(PARTITION BY a1.appr_no) AS last_appr_c_num FROM approval_m a1 JOIN approval_d a2 ON a1.appr_no = a2.appr_no ) b ) c WHERE c.rnum = 1 ) d ON a.appr_no = d.appr_no AND d.appr_admin = 'T'

SELECT m.seq ,m.emp_no ,m.user_nm ,m.proj_code ,m.proj_name ,m.appr_no ,m.rewrite ,d.cont_date ,d.cont_period ,d.move_date ,d.cont_amt ,d.deposit_amt ,d.rent_amt ,d.address ,d.address_d ,d.res_type ,d.trans_type ,d.area ,d.crtdate ,d.accu ,d.accu_type ,d.source ,d.chk_1 ,d.chk_2 ,d.chk_3 ,d.chk_4 ,d.chk_5 ,d.chk_reason_1 ,d.chk_reason_2 ,d.chk_reason_3 ,d.chk_reason_4 ,d.chk_reason_5 ,d.real_estate_files ,d.credit_files ,ifnull(a.appr_stat,'999') as appr_stat ,a.reject FROM contract_m m JOIN contract_d d ON m.seq = d.seq
AND m.proj_code = #{proj_code}
AND m.temp_flag = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN approval_m a ON m.appr_no = a.appr_no WHERE m.EMP_NO = #{user_no}
AND a.appr_stat IS NULL
AND a.appr_stat IN ('0','1','2')
AND a.appr_stat = '3'
AND a.appr_stat = '4'
order by d.crtdate desc
SELECT d.ADDRESS, d.ADDRESS_D, d.POST_CODE, m.TEMP_FLAG FROM contract_d d, contract_m m where m.seq = d.seq
SELECT appr_stat, appr_emp_no, appr_emp_nm, appr_date, appr_stat, reject FROM approval_m
SELECT appr_stat, appr_emp_no, appr_emp_nm, appr_date, appr_stat, reject FROM approval_m WHERE appr_no = #{appr_no}

SELECT d.seq, d.real_estate_files AS real_estate_files, d.credit_files AS credit_files FROM contract_d d WHERE (d.real_estate_files IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.real_estate_files) != '') OR (d.credit_files IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(d.credit_files) != '')
